Can it run GTA VI on PC?

Not yet.

The game's executable (game_scarlett_master.exe) is missing from the package studied, so the game itself has never been started, by AnyXboxX or by Leonida. Once an executable is available, expect at least a few weeks of work before the game is even minimally playable.

Grand Theft Auto VI for Xbox Series, build 1.0.2.1. Status checked on 23 November 2026.

Disk space to plan for

These are work files, on top of the game package itself, which the runtime reads in place. Work folders can go on another drive.

  • ~30 GB
    To run the game

    Leonida's check, shaders and runtime stages.

  • ~370 GB
    Asset export, optional

    Only for the asset tools (models, textures, audio). Not needed to play.

  • ~400 GB
    Full build

    All stages. Sizes as Windows Explorer shows them (GiB): 400 GiB is about 430 GB.

Source: the prerequisites in Leonida's README.

Will my PC run it?

An estimate from your graphics card, processor and memory. Your browser fills in what it can; correct anything it got wrong.

  • Detecting your hardware…

Type your graphics card to see an estimate.

    This is a guess, not a measurement: the game does not run yet. It compares your parts to the Xbox Series X (graphics and processor indexes from public benchmarks, about ±20 %), assumes the console version runs at 30 fps and that translation costs 20 to 60 % more. Real numbers will replace it once the game boots. Detection happens in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

    Where things stand

    • Game executableMissing.Nothing can boot without it.
    • Booting, story modeNo.Waits for the executable.
    • GPU shadersDone.All 26,503 of the game's shaders translate from RDNA 2 to SPIR-V and pass spirv-val (Leonida).
    • Models, textures, audioExported.Read from the player's own copy (Leonida); some texture formats are still partial.
    • Xbox Direct3D 12 to VulkanIn progress.Device, queues and resources work; ray tracing is under way (Leonida).
    • Console system functionsIn progress.AnyXboxX has written 210 of the 396 GDK functions; Leonida has its own. The two projects share their work.

    What you will need, once it works

    • Your own copy of the Xbox Series package, version 1.0.2.1. Nothing here provides it or explains how to get it.
    • Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, and a graphics card with Vulkan.
    • The disk space above.
